nodes.name: pixelle_video/llm_presets.py
nodes.summary: LLM provider preset catalog: predefined OpenAI-compatible provider configurations (Qwen, OpenAI, Claude, DeepSeek, Ollama, Moonshot) with base_url/model/api_key_url, plus lookup helpers.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/models/media.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic model MediaResult describing a generated media artifact (image or video) from ComfyUI workflow execution, with media_type/url/duration and is_image/is_video properties.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/models/progress.py
nodes.summary: ProgressEvent dataclass: structured progress events (event_type, progress 0-1, frame counters, step, action) emitted by pipelines for the UI layer; validates progress range in __post_init__.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/models/storyboard.py
nodes.summary: Storyboard data model layer: StoryboardConfig (generation parameters incl. TTS modes, media workflow, template), StoryboardFrame (per-frame narration/audio/image/video state), ContentMetadata, Storyboard (frames + progress/is_completed), VideoGenerationResult.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/models/workbench.py
nodes.summary: Workbench data model layer for editable local video projects: Project/Scene/AssetVersion/GenerationJob/GenerationRun/GenerationRunItem/ExportRevision dataclasses plus status enums (AssetSource, GenerationKind, GenerationStatus, GenerationRunStatus, GenerationRunItemStatus, GenerationPhase); UTC timestamp helpers.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/pipelines/__init__.py
nodes.summary: Pipelines package barrel: re-exports BasePipeline, LinearVideoPipeline, PipelineContext, StandardPipeline, CustomPipeline, AssetBasedPipeline.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/pipelines/asset_based.py
nodes.summary: AssetBasedPipeline: generates marketing videos from user-provided assets (images/videos) instead of AI-generated media. Analyzes assets via image/video analysis services, builds script with build_asset_script_prompt, matches assets to scenes, composes final video. Uses SceneScript/VideoScript pydantic models.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/pipelines/base.py
nodes.summary: BasePipeline ABC: abstract base for all video generation pipelines. Wires core services (llm, tts, media, video) from PixelleVideoCore; defines async __call__ contract returning VideoGenerationResult and _report_progress helper.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/pipelines/custom.py
nodes.summary: CustomPipeline: template pipeline showing how to extend BasePipeline with custom logic; conditional image generation when template has no {{image}} placeholder; example subclasses MySpecialPipeline and QuickPipeline.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/pipelines/linear.py
nodes.summary: LinearVideoPipeline: template-method base class for linear video generation (setup_environment -> generate_content -> determine_title -> plan_visuals -> initialize_storyboard -> produce_assets -> post_production -> finalize) with PipelineContext dataclass holding per-run state.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/pipelines/standard.py
nodes.summary: StandardPipeline: default general-purpose pipeline (LinearVideoPipeline subclass). Generates narrations from topic or splits fixed script, plans image prompts, produces TTS/media/frames, composes with template, concatenates segments, adds BGM; supports resume via reusable storyboard persistence.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/prompts/__init__.py
nodes.summary: Prompts package barrel: re-exports narration builders (topic/content/title), image prompt builders (image prompt/style conversion/system prompt) and image style presets.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/prompts/asset_script_generation.py
nodes.summary: build_asset_script_prompt: builds the LLM prompt that generates a scene-based video script (SceneScript JSON) from user intent, target duration, and available asset descriptions.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/prompts/content_narration.py
nodes.summary: build_content_narration_prompt: builds the LLM prompt extracting/refining n_storyboard TTS-ready narrations from user-provided content, with language consistency, word-count and integrity constraints.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/prompts/image_generation.py
nodes.summary: Image prompt builders and style presets: IMAGE_STYLE_PRESETS, DEFAULT_IMAGE_STYLE, IMAGE_PROMPT_GENERATION_SYSTEM_PROMPT, build_image_prompt_system_prompt, build_image_prompt_prompt (narration -> English image-generation prompts).

nodes.name: pixelle_video/prompts/storyboard_segmentation.py
nodes.summary: Prompts for extractive narration segmentation: STORYBOARD_SEGMENTATION_SYSTEM_PROMPT, build_storyboard_segmentation_prompt and segmentation_payload_text helper for splitting narration into complete speakable visual segments.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/prompts/style_conversion.py
nodes.summary: build_style_conversion_prompt: converts a user style description (any language) into an English Stable Diffusion/FLUX image generation prompt.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/prompts/title_generation.py
nodes.summary: build_title_generation_prompt: builds the LLM prompt generating a short attractive title from content, with language-consistency and character-limit constraints.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/prompts/topic_narration.py
nodes.summary: build_topic_narration_prompt: builds the LLM prompt generating n storyboard narrations from a topic, with style/emotion/word-count guidance for TTS.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/prompts/video_generation.py
nodes.summary: build_video_prompt_prompt: builds the prompt generating dynamic video-generation prompts from narrations for video models.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/service.py
nodes.summary: PixelleVideoCore: core service layer / composition root. Initializes all services (LLM, TTS, Media, Video, FrameProcessor, Persistence, History, Workbench services), lazily creates ComfyKit, registers pipelines (standard/custom/asset_based), exposes generate_video wrapper and global singleton pixelle_video.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/services/__init__.py
nodes.summary: Services package barrel: re-exports ComfyBaseService, LLMService, TTSService, MediaService (ImageService alias), VideoService, FrameProcessor, PersistenceService, HistoryManager.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/services/comfy_base_service.py
nodes.summary: ComfyBaseService: base class for ComfyUI workflow-based services (TTS, image). Scans/parses workflow files (WORKFLOW_PREFIX/DEFAULT_WORKFLOW/WORKFLOWS_DIR), resolves workflows, prepares ComfyKit config.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/services/continuous_tts/__init__.py
nodes.summary: Continuous TTS package barrel: re-exports assemble helpers (assemble_continuous_script, normalize_tts_delivery, should_use_continuous_tts), split helpers and models for the continuous multi-scene TTS strategy.

nodes.name: pixelle_video/services/continuous_tts/assemble.py
nodes.summary: Continuous TTS assembly: joins multi-scene narrations into one continuous script (assemble_continuous_script), maps delivery labels (normalize_tts_delivery), decides continuous vs per-scene (should_use_continuous_tts), reads delivery from snapshots (delivery_from_snapshot).

nodes.name: MediaResult
nodes.summary: Pydantic BaseModel for a generated media artifact; media_type Literal['image','video'], url, optional duration; is_image/is_video properties.

nodes.name: ProgressEvent
nodes.summary: Dataclass for structured progress events; validates 0.0-1.0 progress in __post_init__.

nodes.name: StoryboardConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding generation parameters: media size, storyboard counts, TTS mode/voice/workflow, media workflow, frame template, composition mode.

nodes.name: StoryboardFrame
nodes.summary: Dataclass for a single storyboard frame: narration, image_prompt, generated resource paths (audio/image/video/segment), subtitle alignment, duration, status and per-step completion.

nodes.name: ContentMetadata
nodes.summary: Dataclass for content metadata (title, author, subtitle, genre, summary, publication_year, cover_url) used for display and narration generation.

nodes.name: Storyboard
nodes.summary: Dataclass composing config + frames + content metadata; tracks final video path, total duration; is_completed and progress properties.

nodes.name: VideoGenerationResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding final video path, storyboard, duration, file size and creation time; returned by all pipelines.

nodes.name: AssetSource
nodes.summary: Enum: AI | UPLOAD — source of a workbench asset.

nodes.name: GenerationKind
nodes.summary: Enum: SCENE | IMAGE | TTS | EXPORT — kind of a generation job.

nodes.name: GenerationStatus
nodes.summary: Enum: PENDING | RUNNING | COMPLETED | FAILED | CANCELLED — job-level status.

nodes.name: GenerationRunStatus
nodes.summary: Enum: QUEUED | RUNNING | PAUSED | COMPLETED | COMPLETED_WITH_FAILURES | CANCELLED | FAILED — generation-run status.

nodes.name: GenerationRunItemStatus
nodes.summary: Enum: QUEUED | RUNNING_TTS | RUNNING_IMAGE | COMPLETED | SKIPPED | FAILED | CANCELLED | CANDIDATE_REVIEW — per-item run status.

nodes.name: GenerationPhase
nodes.summary: Enum: PENDING | RUNNING | COMPLETED | SKIPPED | FAILED | CANCELLED — per-modal phase (tts/image).

nodes.name: Project
nodes.summary: Dataclass for an editable project: title, config dict, project_id, source (quick-create), source_history_task_id, timestamps.

nodes.name: Scene
nodes.summary: Dataclass for a scene within a project: narration, visual_prompt, versioning, audio path, subtitle alignment, duration/hold/mode, status, fingerprints, lock/edit state.

nodes.name: AssetVersion
nodes.summary: Dataclass for an immutable asset version attached to a project/scene: source, relative_path, prompt_snapshot, thumbnail, parameters.

nodes.name: GenerationJob
nodes.summary: Dataclass for an async generation job (kind, task_id, request_snapshot, status, progress, error).

nodes.name: GenerationRun
nodes.summary: Dataclass for a full generation run over project scenes: counts (total/completed/skipped/failed/candidate_review), pause/cancel flags, is_terminal property.

nodes.name: GenerationRunItem
nodes.summary: Dataclass for one scene item inside a run: narration/prompt snapshots, fingerprints, tts_status/image_status (GenerationPhase), skip_reason, is_terminal property.

nodes.name: ExportRevision
nodes.summary: Dataclass for an export revision of a project: snapshot, output_relative_path, status, error.

nodes.name: BasePipeline
nodes.summary: Abstract base class for all video generation pipelines; holds reference to PixelleVideoCore and convenience aliases (llm/tts/media/video/image); abstract __call__ returns VideoGenerationResult; _report_progress helper.

nodes.name: PipelineContext
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding the state of a single linear pipeline execution: input, params, task dir, title, narrations, image prompts, config, storyboard, final path, result.

nodes.name: LinearVideoPipeline
nodes.summary: Template-method pipeline base orchestrating 8 lifecycle steps via __call__; subclasses override steps; exception/cancellation handlers.

nodes.name: StandardPipeline
nodes.summary: Default general-purpose pipeline: topic/fixed-script narration, image prompt planning, TTS/media/frame production, template composition, concat + BGM; asset reuse & resume support.

nodes.name: CustomPipeline
nodes.summary: Template pipeline for custom workflows; conditional image generation when template lacks {{image}}; overrides __call__ and persistence.

nodes.name: MySpecialPipeline
nodes.summary: Documented example subclass of CustomPipeline showing how to customize __call__.

nodes.name: QuickPipeline
nodes.summary: Documented minimal example subclass of BasePipeline implementing __call__ directly.

nodes.name: SceneScript
nodes.summary: Pydantic model for one scene of an asset-based video script: scene_number, asset_path, narrations, duration.

nodes.name: VideoScript
nodes.summary: Pydantic model for a complete asset-based video script (list of SceneScript scenes).

nodes.name: AssetBasedPipeline
nodes.summary: Pipeline generating marketing videos from user-provided assets: asset analysis (image/video analysis services), script generation via LLM (build_asset_script_prompt), asset-scene matching, TTS + frame production + concat.

nodes.name: PixelleVideoCore
nodes.summary: Composition root / service layer: lazy ComfyKit, all service instances, pipeline registry (standard/custom/asset_based), generate_video wrapper; global singleton instance 'pixelle_video'.

nodes.name: ComfyBaseService
nodes.summary: Base service for ComfyUI workflow-based capabilities: workflow scanning/parsing (WORKFLOW_PREFIX, DEFAULT_WORKFLOW, WORKFLOWS_DIR), workflow resolution, ComfyKit config preparation; subclasses: TTS/image services.

nodes.name: build_content_narration_prompt
nodes.summary: Format CONTENT_NARRATION_PROMPT with n_storyboard, word limits and content.

nodes.name: build_image_prompt_system_prompt
nodes.summary: Return system prompt for image-prompt generation with optional style prefix.

nodes.name: build_image_prompt_prompt
nodes.summary: Build prompt converting narrations into English image-generation prompts.

nodes.name: build_storyboard_segmentation_prompt
nodes.summary: Build segmentation prompt preserving source narration exactly with target segment count and max chars.

nodes.name: segmentation_payload_text
nodes.summary: Stable JSON helper for logging/tests without leaking prompt context.

nodes.name: build_style_conversion_prompt
nodes.summary: Format STYLE_CONVERSION_PROMPT with user style description.

nodes.name: build_title_generation_prompt
nodes.summary: Format TITLE_GENERATION_PROMPT with content and max_length.

nodes.name: build_topic_narration_prompt
nodes.summary: Format TOPIC_NARRATION_PROMPT with topic and storyboard settings.

nodes.name: build_video_prompt_prompt
nodes.summary: Build video-prompt generation prompt from narrations.

nodes.summary: Map UI/config labels (per_scene variants) to 'continuous' | 'per_scene'.

nodes.summary: Extract TTS delivery mode from a parameter snapshot (tts.delivery / config.ttsDelivery / config.tts_delivery), defaulting to continuous.

nodes.name: __call__
nodes.summary: Template-method entry point: build PipelineContext, run 8 lifecycle steps, delegate exceptions/cancellation to handlers.

nodes.name: setup_environment
nodes.summary: Step 1: setup task directory and environment (no-op in base).

nodes.name: generate_content
nodes.summary: Step 2: generate or process script/narrations (no-op in base).

nodes.name: determine_title
nodes.summary: Step 3: determine or generate video title (no-op in base).

nodes.name: plan_visuals
nodes.summary: Step 4: generate image prompts / visual descriptions (no-op in base).

nodes.name: initialize_storyboard
nodes.summary: Step 5: create Storyboard and frames (no-op in base).

nodes.name: produce_assets
nodes.summary: Step 6: generate audio, images, render frames (no-op in base).

nodes.name: post_production
nodes.summary: Step 7: concatenate videos, add BGM (no-op in base).

nodes.name: finalize
nodes.summary: Step 8: create result object and persist metadata (NotImplementedError in base).

nodes.name: handle_exception
nodes.summary: Log pipeline execution failures.

nodes.name: handle_cancellation
nodes.summary: Handle cooperative task cancellation.

nodes.name: setup_environment
nodes.summary: Step 1: setup task dir; support resume_task_id by loading reusable storyboard from persistence.

nodes.name: generate_content
nodes.summary: Step 2: generate narrations from topic ('generate' mode) or split fixed script ('fixed' mode).

nodes.name: determine_title
nodes.summary: Step 3: determine or LLM-generate video title.

nodes.name: plan_visuals
nodes.summary: Step 4: generate image prompts per narration (respects template type & image config).

nodes.name: initialize_storyboard
nodes.summary: Step 5: build Storyboard + StoryboardFrames from narrations/prompts.

nodes.name: produce_assets
nodes.summary: Step 6: per-frame TTS audio, media generation, frame processing via core.frame_processor.

nodes.name: post_production
nodes.summary: Step 7: concatenate video segments and add BGM.

nodes.name: finalize
nodes.summary: Step 8: build VideoGenerationResult and persist task metadata/storyboard.

nodes.name: _load_reusable_storyboard
nodes.summary: Load a reusable storyboard for resume; validates asset reuse input keys still present.

nodes.name: _persist_task_data

nodes.name: _persist_running_task_data
nodes.summary: Persist running task data (metadata + storyboard) mid-execution.

nodes.name: handle_exception
nodes.summary: Persist failure state to task metadata on pipeline error.

nodes.name: handle_cancellation
nodes.summary: Persist cancelled state to task metadata on cancellation.

nodes.name: __call__
nodes.summary: Entry point: init asset index, run lifecycle (setup_environment..finalize), return VideoGenerationResult.

nodes.name: setup_environment
nodes.summary: Step 1: resolve assets, create task output dir, analyze each asset via image/video analysis services.

nodes.name: determine_title
nodes.summary: Step 3: resolve video title from input or config.

nodes.name: generate_content
nodes.summary: Step 2: build asset script prompt, call core.llm for SceneScript/VideoScript, match assets to scenes.

nodes.name: plan_visuals
nodes.summary: Step 4: plan visuals (narration-consistent prompts) from script scenes.

nodes.name: initialize_storyboard
nodes.summary: Step 5: build Storyboard from script scenes and asset paths.

nodes.name: produce_assets
nodes.summary: Step 6: TTS per scene + frame processing for composed segments.

nodes.name: post_production
nodes.summary: Step 7: concatenate segments with core.video.concat_videos.

nodes.name: finalize
nodes.summary: Step 8: build result and persist task metadata/storyboard.

nodes.name: _persist_task_data
nodes.summary: Persist task metadata and storyboard via core.persistence.

edges.note: Parallel data-model layers: legacy generation models (storyboard) vs editable project models (workbench)
PixelleVideoCore exposes workbench services consuming workbench models
LinearVideoPipeline implements the BasePipeline contract via template method
Both configure LLM interactions (provider presets vs prompt builders)
